description.content:
The PlayCanvas REST API lets you automate the PlayCanvas platform — manage project assets, branches and checkpoints (version control), list scenes, export projects, download self-hostable apps, poll asynchronous jobs, and publish Gaussian splats to the SuperSplat platform. The API is currently in beta; endpoints and responses may change. All access is over HTTPS using a Bearer access token generated on your Organization's Account page.
